# INV-THIRD for C001: three of a line priced at 100/3 CAD, posted for 100.00.
#
# A price no decimal says exactly is written as the fraction it is, and the
# export writes it back that way, so the line has to read back as itself.
#
# What this fixture produces: customer C001 and INV-THIRD posted to
# Assets:Accounts Receivable for 100.00 CAD.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_line_priced_at_a_fraction_reads_back_as_itself.py.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-THIRD"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "A third of a job, three times"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 3
		price: 100/3
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-THIRD"
		accumulate: true
	payment: none
